editorial_review_row.content: City Index scores 8.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. An FCA-regulated broker with a 41-year track record, backed by NASDAQ-listed StoneX Group, offering 13,500+ markets across spread bets and CFDs. Tax-free spread betting for UK residents is a genuine financial edge. Execution averages 20ms with 99.99% success rate. FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000. The trade-off — spreads start at 0.5 pips (not the cheapest), a £12 monthly inactivity fee kicks in after 12 months, and Premium pricing requires £10,000. Legitimate, stable, and built for serious UK and Australian traders who value safety over rock-bottom costs.
